name: Perry County, Indiana (United States)
description: White field charged with an outline map of the county in green, blue and white — trees above and river waves below — over the date 1814 in black.
history: Perry County is a county located in the southwestern part of Indiana. The flag was adopted on 5 August 1989 (adopted on 5 August 1989 for the 175th anniversary of the county in Indiana, according to Flags of the World quoting the county code).

features.role: map of the county with trees and river waves in green, blue and white
